node.title: G-04 — Factorial de coordinación y contraste FH-C con mecanismos observables

relations: A source-native factorial can make a bounded FH-C question more falsifiable without turning a synthetic mechanism into demonstrated real-world causal priority.
La nota FH-C permanece hipotética; el protocolo nuevo es Stage A en una rama abierta, no Stage B/C o validación de campo.
The coordination-entropy account can motivate a factorial test of information and joint-transition mechanisms, including cases where clarity alone does not activate capability.
Es una pregunta de investigación posterior, no una explicación causal ya demostrada de los programas históricos.
